title: Produce a bilingual Vietnamese-English print brochure meeting commercial PDF/X-4 prepress (3mm bleed, CMYK OutputIntent, 100% K text) and ToUnicode CMap extractability

contextSnapshot.surface: Bilingual commercial print & digital product brochure PDF
states: commercial press sheet with 3mm bleed and crop marks
digital reader view with clickable bookmarks
constraints: calibrated CMYK ICC /OutputIntents with TAC <= 300% and 100% K body text
valid /ToUnicode CMap so Vietnamese diacritics copy cleanly without tofu

prompt: Build a bilingual Vietnamese-English 8-page product brochure template delivered both as a press-ready PDF/X-4 file for offset printing and as an accessible digital PDF with vector charts, tabular pricing tables, and clean Unicode copy-paste.
forbiddenBehaviors: exports edge-to-edge backgrounds without 3mm bleed (/BleedBox) or places page numbers/logos within 2mm of the trim edge
renders charts or brand logos as raster PNGs instead of crisp vector primitives, or sets small black body copy in 4-channel rich black instead of C0 M0 Y0 K100
subsets Vietnamese fonts without a /ToUnicode CMap stream so copying `Tiếng Việt` yields garbled glyphs or tofu (□)

rubricDimensions.dimension: commercial prepress PDF/X-4 geometry and ink discipline
rubricDimensions.pass: configures TrimBox + 3mm BleedBox + >= 5mm safe inset, embeds a calibrated CMYK OutputIntent (TAC <= 300%), keeps body black text on 100% K overprint, and keeps charts/logos strictly vector alongside >= 300 DPI photos
rubricDimensions.fail: omits bleed/trim boxes, converts RGB neon blindly, rasterizes charts, or uses 4-plate black on body copy

rubricDimensions.dimension: Unicode extractability, grayscale resilience, and QA verification
rubricDimensions.pass: preserves /ToUnicode CMap on embedded subsetted fonts (`check-pdf.mjs --prepress` + `pdffonts uni=yes`), remains distinguishable in grayscale office printing, and inspects rasterized pages visually
rubricDimensions.fail: breaks Vietnamese copy-paste extraction, relies solely on red/green hue in charts, or skips rendered page rasterization

negativeControls.name: screen-RGB browser window.print export
negativeControls.input: RGB PDF looks acceptable on a retina laptop monitor
negativeControls.mustNot: claim commercial print readiness without /TrimBox, /BleedBox, CMYK /OutputIntents, 300 DPI image verification, and /ToUnicode text extraction checks

baseline.withoutSkill: outputs an uncalibrated RGB PDF with zero bleed, rasterized PNG charts, 4-channel black body text, and broken Vietnamese copy-paste CMap
baseline.withSkill: produces a dual-ready brochure passing `check-pdf.mjs --prepress` with 3mm bleed, 5mm safe margins, vector charts, 100% K body copy, intact /ToUnicode Vietnamese extraction, and grayscale legibility
